title: ophrys sphegodes subsp. alasiatica
intro: Ophrys sphegodes subsp. alasiatica, commonly known as the Bee Orchid, is a type of flowering plant in the Orchidaceae family. The Bee Orchid has been studied for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is believed to have a positive effect on cardiovascular health and immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys sphegodes subsp. alasiatica include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of the Bee Orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
